versions.changelog:
- Marked the skill as DEPRECATED in SKILL.md.
- Added clear instructions to use the canonical skill file instead.
- Removed all previous documentation and guidance from SKILL.md.
- Kept the file minimal to prevent usage of outdated information.

Added: language matching (output in user's language), cross-chapter/cross-book connections, chapter jumping (no forced linear order), application layer requires explicit user confirmation, removed ambiguous Light Mode. Ultimate goal: user grasps ~80% of each chapter after deepdive.

English version. Core: content-drive principle added — 9 tasks as checklist not template, allow skipping/merging, prevent formulaic output. Added judgment criterion: reader must feel the unique character of each chapter.
Added content-drive principle: 9 tasks as checklist not template. Allow skipping/merging, prevent formulaic output. Added judgment criterion for quality.
